data.label: include
data.reason_zh: 摘要提出 CausalEvo，用反馈案例评估候选规则并保留高排名技能，跨进化步骤累积可复用技能，属于持续自改进方法。

scope_support.feedback_quote: skill replacements against shared background rules are scored on the same feedback cases; least squares converts the score differences into relative skill values, and the top-ranked rules are retained
scope_support.object_quote: At each evolution step, a frozen LLM proposes candidate rules, which are pooled with the incumbent skills so that the current skill set remains a feasible choice.
scope_support.persistence_quote: Deciding which skills to retain is consequential: useful rules improve later answers
